motion.name: state-only
motion.value: spinner while busy; no page-load choreography
motion.purpose: Product motion: feedback, not intro theater.

narrative.overview: A bench, not a cockpit. One surface for running a model, building skills, and connecting tools. Restrained cyan/violet; say each fact once.
keyCharacteristics: One identity, one model, one prompt

rules.name: The Ten-Percent Rule
rules.body: Cyan and violet together occupy ≤10% of the frame.

rules.name: The One-Home Rule
rules.body: Model string in header or status bar, never both.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Do not prefix every region with uppercase labels when tabs already name the page.

rules.name: The Flat-Hub Rule
rules.body: Header, main, prompt. No nested cards around the transcript.

dos: Do put the conversation in the largest rectangle after header + prompt.
Do show only tools that are present.
Do keep Manual confirm for writes.
donts: Don't list every unsupported tool as an empty circle.
Don't run a fake NASA boot sequence.
Don't repeat brand, model, or nav hints on three surfaces.
Don't use emoji in tabs or headers.
Don't advertise 1/2/3 as page keys on Chat.
